svg.title: serve-cp
svg.desc: Context parallelism over P GPUs. Ring Attention keeps each GPU’s query block and passes K/V blocks around a ring; communication hides behind compute when the block has at least F/B tokens: 1.0K on A100 NVLink, 24.5K on A100 InfiniBand (reported). DeepSpeed-Ulysses all-to-alls from a token split to a head split, moving 4Nh/P per link but needing P ≤ heads. Computed bytes received per GPU per layer at N = 128K, P = 8, BF16: MHA 64 heads, ring 4 GiB vs Ulysses 1 GiB; GQA 64/8, ring 512 MiB vs Ulysses 576 MiB.
